SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 4444
Special Branch S.34
REPORT
Date January 31, 1933.
Subject (in full) Interviews granted to Chinese Pressmen by the ex-communists
Huang Pin (黄平), Yui Fei (余飞) and Hsu Hsi Keng (徐锡根).
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [签名]
With reference to the attached cutting from the
Shanghai Sunday Times dated January 29, 1933, on the subject of
interviews granted to Chinese pressmen by the ex-communist
leaders Huang Pin (黄平), Yui Fei (余飞) and Hsu Hsi Keng
(徐锡根) at Nanking on January 27, I have to state that
Hsu Hsi Keng formed the subject of a report forwarded by the
undersigned on January 25.
Regarding the statement that Paul Noulens was formerly
secretary to Yui Fei, efforts to verify this have been
unsuccessful. Yui Fei, who was arrested by the Chinese
Authorities at Pengpu in August last, however, claims that
he at one time was the Chairman of the Far Eastern Bureau
of the Pan Pacific Trade Union Secretariat of which body
Paul Noulens was the secretary.
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
[签名]
31.1.33.

报告
日期：1933年1月31日。
事由（全称）：前共产党人黄平、余飞和徐锡根接受中国记者采访。
由警探库宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）撰写。转发者 [签名]
关于附上的1933年1月29日《上海星期泰晤士报》剪报，其内容涉及前共产党领导人黄平、余飞和徐锡根于1月27日在南京接受中国记者采访一事，本人须说明，徐锡根系本人于1月25日 forwarded 的一份报告的主题。
关于保罗·努伦斯（Paul Noulens）曾任余飞秘书的说法，经核实未果。然而，去年八月在蚌埠被中国当局逮捕的余飞声称，他曾任泛太平洋工会秘书处远东局主席，而保罗·努伦斯是该机构的秘书。
库宝华
警探
特务科主管。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, JANUARY 29, 1933

Communist Leaders Disavow
Cause And Urge Unity
Well-known Chinese “Reds” Give Interview At
Nanking Pleading For Nationwide Support
Of Kuomintang; Only Way To Fight

NANKING, Jan. 27.—A very rare and significant occasion was provided this afternoon, when three of the highest Communist leaders granted an interview to Chinese pressmen, in which they expressed in very frank language the necessity of the Chinese people uniting to face the present national crisis and to resist Japanese aggression.

They declared it would be a very grave error if Chinese Communists and labour leaders interfered with the Kuomintang’s programme for national recon-struction and resistance to Japanese aggression. In fact, they stated that they were prepared to co-operate with the Kuomintang in every way possible to save the country from its present peril.

The three leaders who gave the interview were: Mr. Chen Tu-hsiu, former Secretary-General of the Com-munist Party; a delegate to the Communist Internationale in 1928; a member of the Central Executive Committee of the World Communist Party and Chairman of the Shanghai Labour Communist Union.

“Unity Essential”

All three of them strongly denied the reports that the resumption of relations between China and the Soviet would mean the spread of Communism in China, and they further declared that the present policy of the Soviet Government was one of peace and non-interference in the internal affairs of other countries. They further emphasized the point that the only way to save China was through unity and co-operation between all parties and factions, and that the Communists were ready to sink their differences and work together with the Kuomintang for the salvation of the country.

《上海星期泰晤士报》，1933年1月29日

共产党领导人否认
其主张并呼吁团结
知名中国“赤色分子”在南京接受采访，恳请全国支持
国民党；此为抗战唯一途径

南京，1月27日电。——今天下午出现了一个非常罕见且意义重大的场合，三位最高级别的共产党领导人接受了中国记者的采访，他们以非常坦率的语言表达了中国人民必须团结起来面对当前国家危机并抵抗日本侵略的必要性。

他们宣称，如果中国共产主义者和劳工领袖干扰国民党的国家重建及抵抗日本侵略的计划，将是一个极其严重的错误。事实上，他们表示准备在各方面与国民党合作，以使国家摆脱当前的危难。

接受采访的三位领导人是：陈独秀先生，前共产党总书记；1928年共产国际代表；世界共产党中央执行委员会委员兼上海劳工共产主义联盟主席。

“团结至关重要”

他们三人都强烈否认了有关中苏恢复关系意味着共产主义在中国传播的报道，并进一步声明，苏联政府目前的政策是和平且不干涉他国内政。他们进一步强调，拯救中国的唯一途径是通过各党派和派系之间的团结与合作，共产党人愿意搁置分歧，与国民党共同为救国而努力。
